instruction: Start with dogbone_slots.step. Open the part in FreeCAD from `/usr/bin/freecad`, then carry out the Path workbench edits when working on `dogbone_slots.step`. Create a FreeCAD Path/CAM Job. Machine the four rectangular joinery slots using Slot or Pocket operations, add dogbone compensation at every internal corner so an 8 mm wide rectangular tenon can fit, and cut through to bottom Z=0. T1 is an 8 mm end mill for slots and dogbone relief. Use the Job, stock/setup, origin, ToolBit/ToolController, operation, toolpath verification, and Path postprocessor dialogs as needed. Post the required G-code/NC output file(s) to the output folder using exactly these absolute file paths: /home/user/Desktop/task-18.nc.
